Get ready to experience the ultimate blend of speed and fun with The Crew Motorfest Season 9. Launching for free on March 4, this new season will let you get behind the wheel of NASCAR vehicles, empowers you to create unforgettable tracks with the all-new Trackforge, and introduces a bold new way to experience Motorfest through Remote Control cars!

Mixtape is coming May 7, 2026 to PlayStation 5.

Make out. Sneak out. Hang out.

On their last night together, three friends embark on one final adventure. Play through a mixtape of memories, set to the soundtrack of a generation.

En route to their final party together, a perfectly curated playlist draws three friends into dreamlike reenactments of their formative memories. Experience a variety of narrative vignettes exploring the pivotal moments that shaped them. Players will immerse themselves in the teenage wasteland by playing through a mixtape of joyful gameplay, from skateboarding and flying to taking photos after hours at an abandoned theme park, hitting baseballs, and putting on a fireworks show from the backseat of a car. It's the greatest hits of the teenage experience, from the first kiss to the last dance.

Scott Pilgrim EX is an action-adventure brawler where players fight across the fractured time and space of Toronto in a brand-new story by series creator Bryan Lee O’Malley and developer Tribute Games.

Battle as Scott Pilgrim, Ramona Flowers, Matthew Patel, Lucas Lee, Roxie Richter, Robot-01 — and Gideon Graves, the final playable Evil Ex — each with their own distinct combat style.

Combat is driven by instinct and improvisation - a hectic ballet of fists and flair that rewards strategy, spontaneity, and a good bit of brawling chaos. String together stylish combos, experiment with wacky weapons, unleash over-the-top special attacks, and upgrade your fighter with badges that unlock new abilities and enhance your stats.

Explore a seamless, interconnected Toronto, complete quests, discover hidden secrets, and team up in local or online co-op for up to four players.

The rails are calling. Will you answer?

Grind through sky high tracks in city skylines, flip across oceans and drift across the railways of a dystopian Japan whilst chaining stylish combos in Denshattack! After the climate crisis ravaged the world and left humanity to survive in domes;  the Miraido megagorp dominated the land with their supersonic railway systems. However a movement is rising to reclaim the old forgotten rails!

Denshattack! is a high -adrenaline fuelled ride that sees you multi-drifting and kick-flipping your customisable train across 50+ levels of Japan's scenery whilst fighting enormous mechs and bosses AND clashing with rival gangs. Complete objectives, race rivals and perfect your combos! Do you have what it takes to be the next legendary Denshattacker!?

Backed by a hard hitting soundtrack from Tee Lopes (Sonic Mania, TMNT: Shredder’s Revenge) and more, this will be an experience beyond the visual!
